{{Quote|Stay calm, in moments we'll be able to create a medic. Then we can find Attichitcuk and bring him back.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca|audio=HerrDoktor.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Members of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] built a '''medical droid''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] for the purpose of saving [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], a [[Wookiee Chieftain]] who had been shot and gravely injured by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The medical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] traveled to Attichitcuk's location along with a party of Wookiees led by his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], where the droid was able to give enough medical aid to save the Chieftain's life.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Now, assemble your warriors and your medic at the edge of town and go find Attichitcuk.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca|audio=TU4-WNARN-L46.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Rescue of Attichitcuk.png|thumb|right|200px|The medical droid accompanied the Wookiee warriors during their mission to rescue Attichitcuk.]]
During the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] effort of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]<ref name="GB" /> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> some Wookiees constructed a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] on orders from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who was assigned to oversee the colonization. The Wookiees built the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base's]] [[command center]] for the purpose of healing [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], the leader of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]. Attichitcuk had been [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|shot]] and critically wounded by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conglomerate that wanted to take Alaris Prime illegally.<ref name="GB" />

The newly assembled medical droid set off with a band of Wookiee [[bowcaster trooper]]s led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Attichitcuk's [[Gender/Legends|son]], into the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] to [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue]] the Wookiee leader. After encountering and defeating several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] en route, the Wookiees found Attichitcuk, and the medical droid was able to heal him enough to allow him to walk back to the base. The medical droid and the Wookiee [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] then returned to the base, defeating several more battle droids along the way, including three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] that attacked them at the settlement. Attichitcuk, still needing to recuperate from his wounds, was prevented from participating too heavily in the colonization effort for some [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="GB" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|If any of your troopers are badly wounded, you should take a moment to apply first aid.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca|audio=SafetyFirst.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The [[Class one droid/Legends|class one droid]]<ref name="Core Rulebook" /> was part of a [[Wookiee medical droid|medical droid model]] built by the Wookiees. The droid moved around on a set of wheels and had two mechanical [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. The medical droid was skilled enough to get Attichitcuk back on his feet after he was critically wounded by [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Okay, click on your command center and create a Wookiee medic.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the player|audio=WookieeMedic.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The Wookiee medical droid was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The droid appears in the fourth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Researching Technology," and is constructed at the player's command center at the cost of thirty-five [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] units. The player may create multiple medical droids, but an image of Attichitcuk being rescued shows one droid, establishing [[canon]]ically that the Wookiees constructed only a single medical droid.<ref name="GB" />
